settle:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Production transparent PNG sprite sheet, tender cat settling down animation. Image1 is the exact START pose: a round gray-white strawberry cat in low half-rise with short front legs and a relaxed sideways gaze. Image2 is the exact END pose: the same cat in low idle crouch. Preserve both identities, proportions, strawberry cream waffle, blue eyes, fur marks, thick warm-dark contours, shading and fluffy tail.
Generate EIGHT smooth consecutive intermediate poses arranged EXACTLY 4 columns x2 rows, equal square cells, output2048x1024, true RGBA transparent background. NO labels, shadows, panels, grid or extra elements. Generous transparent clearance: each cat no larger than 75% of cell width, 80% cell height, complete tail visible; every cat must have at least45px EMPTY space to all cell borders. Fixed feet groundline and identical camera and scale across all eight frames. Ground at y=460 in each cell. Never crop tail.
The cat softly lowers its shoulders to the ground, with a relaxed slow blink, then reopens the eyes when comfortable. This is a DIFFERENT downward movement, not a rigid reversal of standing up. Hips stay down, no tall body, no elongation.
F1 matches image1 exactly in half-rise. F2 upper eyelids lower to half and chin gently dips, forelegs bend slightly. F3 eyes peacefully fully closed, shoulders lower one third. F4 eyes closed, shoulders lower two thirds, head relaxed2degrees down. F5 closed eyes, forepaws softly spread as chest finishes lowering, lowest position, very subtle squash. F6 low crouch matching image2 body, eyes begin opening20%. F7 low crouch with eyes60% open, gaze centers gradually. F8 matches image2's original crouch and open eyes exactly.
Keep head size and decoration size absolutely constant throughout, keep paws at groundline, only small shoulder/head motion about25px between start/end at this scale. The final expression is sweet and relaxed. No humanoid sitting, no upright staring eyes during lowering. Same cat smoothly settling, no unrelated new drawings.
sleep:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Production animated desktop pet transparent sprite sheet. Edit the supplied approved low-crouching strawberry gray-white cat into a calm FALLING ASLEEP AND BREATHING sequence. Preserve exactly this character identity, huge fluffy round head, blue eyes, white muzzle and front paws, pink cheeks, gray fluffy tail on viewer's right, strawberry with green leaves, white cream, golden waffle and thick warm-dark contour. Fixed head size and fixed camera.
Output EXACTLY 12 sequential full-character poses in a strict FOUR columns by THREE rows grid, read left to right then down. Use true RGBA transparency. Prefer 2048x1536. Each square cell has generous blank margins; cat full width INCLUDING tail no greater than75% of cell width. Leave at least45 pixels clear on ALL four edges. NO cropping, labels, shadows, ground planes, text, panels, borders.
Sequence is gentle, tender, weighted and sleepy. The kitten lowers its head a small amount onto its forepaws, closes its eyelids gradually, lets its shoulders relax. It must NOT appear as a rigid vertical translation or scaling.
Frame1 original awake crouch exactly. Frame2 eyelids80%open with gaze softly down, head2px lower. Frame3 eyelids55%open, head5px lower. Frame4 eyelids25%open, head10px lower. Frame5 eyes peacefully CLOSED, head14px lower. Frame6 closed eyes and chin gently sinks toward forepaws, head20px lower, ears relax just a little. Frame7 chin settles onto paws, body softly compresses, closed relaxed smiling eyelids. Frame8 resting asleep, stable head/chin resting low, tail relaxed but entirely visible, this is the baseline sleeping pose.
Frames9,10,11,12 are one VERY SUBTLE breathing cycle while remaining asleep in EXACTLY frame8 pose: F9 inhale partway, rib/chest fluff expands2px; F10 inhale peak expands4px, shoulders raise ONLY2px; F11 exhale partway, chest returns2px; F12 completely matches sleeping frame8 at rest. Paws and tail base remain planted, eyes CLOSED unchanged, no size/hat wobble. The head decorations move with the head, never independently.
All12 cats identical scale, same width, head size, fur styling, colors. All forepaw bottoms on exactly same relative groundline y=458 inside each cell. Sleep head drops only about20px overall, no large squashing of head, no weird bent anatomy. No blanket or extra sleeping symbols.
